rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when demystification means making a confusing topic clear through explanation.

example.english: Could you explain the principle clearly? That would be a helpful demystification for me.
example.traditional: 你可唔可以將個原理講清楚，等我唔使再估？
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go3 jyun4 lei5 gong2 cing1 co2 dang2 ngo5 m4 sai2 zoi3 gu2

rows.note: Use this specifically for clearing up doubts or confusion, especially in formal contexts.

example.english: This report provides demystification by answering the questions that concern the public most.
example.traditional: 呢份報告有助釋疑，解答咗市民最關心嘅問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan2 bou3 gou3 jau5 zo6 sik1 ji4 gaai2 daap3 zo2 si5 man4 zeoi3 gwaan1 sam1 ge3 man6 tai4

rows.jyutping: kit3 hoi1 san4 bei3 min6 saa1
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on revealing what was mysterious or deliberately obscured.

example.english: The documentary finally offers a demystification of the ancient site by revealing the truth behind it.
example.traditional: 套紀錄片終於揭開神秘面紗，講出古蹟背後嘅真相。
example.jyutping: tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 zung1 jyu1 kit3 hoi1 san4 bei3 min6 saa1 gong2 ceot1 gu2 zik1 bui3 hau6 ge3 zan1 soeng3
